findings.statement: The folded winning-line orientation families available on a finite carrier depend on board geometry and K; 6x3-k4 has only H, not H/V/D.
Because horizontal-only 6x3-k4 has a nonzero 16-dimensional OOO correction with five degree-2 contradictions, simultaneous H,V,D interaction cannot be the general source of the surviving OOO layer.

Persistence of OOO across k=3 and k=4 remains evidence against a simple k-1 companion-count explanation, but it does not support a universal three-orientation explanation because one hard k=4 carrier has only one available orientation family.
6x3-k4 is now a decisive control for any proposed deeper structural law: a common explanation must admit an H-only realization while also covering mixed-orientation carriers.

nonclaims: Orientation is not claimed irrelevant on carriers that contain V or D lines.
This does not identify the final scalar syndrome.
